What are Human Soft Skills?

Introduction to Human Soft Skills
Simone Maienfisch · 5 min

💡 The Core Insight

Humans guide and decide what matters. AI produces content. It's always a plus+ — not AI or human.

The Framework

Why this matters

The skills in this framework are not new. What's new is that working with AI amplifies their importance. As AI becomes better at generating information, humans get more value by framing, connecting, challenging, deciding, and governing the AI output.

When AI increasingly generates, analyzes, recommends, and produces content — humans need to increasingly synthesize, judge, decide, verify, and create meaning.

24 Skills Across 3 Categories
🧠

Thinking

10 skills

Stakeholder management, systems thinking, synthesis, decision making, judgement, fact checking, critical thinking, policies, ethics, and metacognition.

🤝

Collaborate with AI

5 skills

Speed reading, context building, problem framing, asking good questions, and editing & refinement.

💭

Mindset

9 skills

Refinement loops, AI culture, sustainability, communication, creativity, intellectual humility, curiosity, cognitive independence, and patience.
